entry.title: CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent
entry.summary: CBSE held a live Q&A webinar on 29 Sept 2026 about Registration and LOC for the 2027 board exams. Schools were urged to submit correct student details and subject combinations. The LOC process for Class X and XII has begun, and Registration for Classes IX and XI will start shortly.

entry.title: Press Release : CBSE Declares Class X Second Board Examination Results 2026
